assessments.reasoning: The Wave paragraphs define wave size as active-lane capacity, constrain capacities to powers of two, and state the one-through-capacity range for active lanes.

challenge.method: Apply the given capacity and count conditions to two candidate integer counts and a non-power-of-two capacity. Compare the separate quad rule, the remainder lanes, and the execution-model condition for lane activity.
challenge.results: In a hypothetical size-32 wave, an active count of 19 fits the documented range even though 19 cannot itself be the wave size. A capacity of 24 fails the power-of-two constraint. The clause on four active lanes applies to a quad operation, and the scheduler text separately declines to guarantee every lane is executing.

limitations: The abstract examples do not assert a particular GPU width, scheduling strategy, or ability to run a particular operation.
